tha-ap93:1.1: Timirapupphiyavaggo navamo. [91. Sudhāpiṇḍiya.] Pūjārahe pūjayato Buddhe yadi va sāvake / papañcasamatikkante tiṇṇasokapariddave. // //
tha-ap93:2.1: Te tādise pūjayato nibbute akutobhaye / na sakkā puññaṃ saṅkhātuṃ ime ttaṃ api kenaci. // //
tha-ap93:3.1: Catunnam api dīpānaṃ issaraṃ yodhakāraye / ekissā pūjanāy' etaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ. // //
tha-ap93:4.1: Siddhatthassa naraggassa cetiye phalitantare / sudhāpiṇḍo mayā dinno vippasannena cetasā. // //
tha-ap93:5.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi paṭisaṅkhārass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap93:7.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap93:8.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sudhāpiṇḍiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
